versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g If for a Synchronized Time Domain a cyclic or im- mediate transmission of a SYNC message is requested, the Time Master shall 1. get current Synchronized Time Base's Time Tuple as [T0 SYNC ;T0 VLT ] via StbM_- BusGetCurrentTime and 2. call CanIf_Transmit with the seconds portion of T0 SYNC written to Sync- TimeSec field of the message data.
